key_insight: MANDALA is an E(3)-equivariant GNN framework that learns electronic-structure operators, not just energies and forces, enabling direct prediction of quantum observables.
engineering_relevance: It provides a scalable path to recover band structures, densities of states, charge distributions, and electron counts for materials modeling workflows that need electronic detail beyond standard MLIPs.
method: Unified block-sparse representation of Hamiltonian, overlap, and density matrices
Modular pipeline for basis conversion, sparse block handling, irrep mapping, graph construction, model definition, and training
evidence_signal: The abstract states that MANDALA evaluates observables such as band energy, electron count, density of states, and band structure directly from predicted electronic-structure matrices.
watch_item: Performance will depend on the quality of basis conversion and sparse operator reconstruction, which may add implementation complexity across different backends and chemistries.
paper_title: MANDALA: An E(3)-Equivariant Graph Neural Network Framework for Learning Electronic-Structure Operators with Observable Guidance
